next_step.title: Re-point the ways in, then retire the old tab
next_step.text: The Courses List's panel now carries the common course's card and its edits; next, SkyView, Quickstart and Subjects open the List, the auditor's other tags become List filters, then the Common Course Reference tab is deleted. The side session's own handoff is docs/courses_retirement_handoff.md.

changes.text: A course's panel in the Courses List shows its common course and, for a signed-in reviewer, Rename, Set the discipline and Confirm, carried from the Common Course Reference tab (#2776).
The sign-in link lands in the shared session file and returns to the view it was asked from (#2775); the old tab had landed every sign-in.
The Course page and the Commons card count cards a person has confirmed in SkyView beside ready: 812 of 27,581 (#2726).
COCI Lookup's Progress view draws the Common Course Reference's opened page from the Commons' own row: 3,205 of 27,581 cards ready (#2720).
COCI Lookup's Courses view is the Courses List: 141,738 local courses banded by today's M-ID, read only, Open in SkyView on each band (#2670).
